question.text: When <math><mi>X</mi><msub><mrow><mi>O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is fused with an alkali metal hydroxide in presence of an oxidizing agent such as <math><msub><mrow><mi>KNO</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>; a dark green product is formed which disproportionate in acidic solution to afford a dark purple solution. <math><mi>X</mi></math> is:

solution.text: When XO2 is fused with an alkali metal hydroxide in presence of an oxidizing agent such as KNO3; a dark green product is formed which disproportionate in acidic solution to afford a dark purple solution. X is Mn
